title: How Mexico tracked down 'El Mencho' through one of the drug kingpin’s girlfriends
summary: Nemesio Oseguera, known as "El Mencho", died Sunday following an operation by the Mexican army that followed one of his romantic partners to a village where they were meeting. He was one of the most wanted drug lords in Mexico and the US, with a bounty of up to $15 million on his head.
